action.name: Multiattack
entries: Ivlis makes three Chaos Blast attacks. She can replace one attack with a use of Sinister Command if available.

action.name: Chaos Blast
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) damage. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the damage type: 1, Acid; 2, Cold; 3, Fire; 4, Lightning.

action.name: Sinister Command {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, one creature Ivlis can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. While {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
